description: Relates mass, molarity, volume and molecular weight (mass g = M x L x g/mol). Give molarity to get the mass needed, or give mass to get the molarity. For laboratory calculations only.

mass.description: Mass of solute. Give this or molarity, not both.

molarity.description: Target molarity. Give this or mass, not both.

mw.description: Molecular weight in g/mol. Must be greater than 0.

volume.description: Solution volume. Must be greater than 0.

name: molarity
title: Molarity
